records.business_description:
Axies Ventures is a junior mineral exploration company focused on the discovery and development of copper and gold assets in Cyprus and Canada.

Axies Ventures’ portfolio of interests in Cyprus consists of prospecting and reconnaissance permits (the “Cyprus Projects”). The Cyprus Projects cover an area of approximately 36 km2 and are predominantly located on the northern flanks of the Troodos Mountains, Cyprus. 

In addition, the Company holds a number of mineral claims across four non-contiguous properties in Canada (the “Canadian Projects”). The Canadian Projects cover an area of approximately 43 km2 and are all located in the province of Ontario, Canada.

Axies Ventures’ main country of operation is Cyprus.

Liberty Minerals is a mineral exploration company focused on tungsten, with interests in antimony, molybdenum copper, silver and zinc within Arizona and Idaho, USA.  It was established on 4 February 2026 as a UK registered company for the purpose of holding all of the US mining assets of Liberty Minerals Holding, Inc. and progressing the exploration and development of those assets. On Admission, the Company will hold two mining assets comprising the Boriana and Buckhorn projects (the “Projects”). The Projects consist of unpatented mining claims located entirely on land managed by the United States Bureau of Land Management.

The Directors believe that the combination of a suite of US based mining assets within a single, US-focused AIM-quoted vehicle creates an opportunity to pursue exploration and development of tungsten and associated mineral targets. Historically, Boriana was one of Arizona’s principal historical tungsten mine producers and it is the Directors’ opinion that it holds highly prospective tungsten targets.  The Company’s main focus will be on the Boriana project with Buckhorn being a secondary target for future exploration and development over the longer term.

On 4 June 2026, the Company raised gross proceeds of £662,000 through a pre-IPO Fundraise undertaken by Oak Securities through the issue of CLNs, convertible on Admission at a discount of 25% to the Placing Price.

The Company is seeking admission of its Enlarged Share Capital to trading on AIM and to raise £TBC (before expenses) through a placing to finance the further exploration and development of the Boriana and Buckhorn Projects.

On Admission, Liberty Minerals plc will hold the entire issued share capital of Liberty Minerals Holding, Inc. which will hold the entire issued share capital of the following three US entities:
-	Liberty Minerals, Inc.
-	Boriana Minerals, Inc.
-	Boriana Copper and Tungsten, Inc.

The Company, with its wholly-owned subsidiaries (together, the "Group"), is a precision engineering business focused on the design, manufacture and support of specialist hole-drilling systems used in the production of aero engine and industrial gas turbine components. The Group's principal operating subsidiary, TEK 4 Limited, was incorporated in December 2003 and manufactures at its site in Blaby, Leicestershire.

The Group provides customers with a broad suite of specialist cooling-hole manufacturing solutions from a single supplier, including electrical discharge machining (EDM), laser drilling, laser ablation and shaped tube electrolytic machining (STEM/ECM), enabling customers to produce the complex cooling-hole geometries required by increasingly high-temperature aero engines and industrial gas turbines. In April 2026, the Group acquired Innolas (UK) Limited, adding femtosecond laser and micromachining capability and supporting the Group's entry into adjacent medical device and semi-conductor applications.

The Group's customers include a number of leading aerospace and industrial gas turbine manufacturers and tier one component suppliers.

The Group's main country of operation is the UK.

Voltage X is an AI-native creative and communications group. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, the Group provides public relations, digital marketing, content creation, marketing analytics and influencer management services to an international client base, with a primary focus on the real estate, hospitality, sports and retail sectors.

The Group employs AI-enabled marketing platforms and digital intellectual property licensed to brands. The Group uses AI to support its service offering, focusing in particular on social media-based advertising placements and the monitoring of audience and competitor behaviour. The Directors believe that the use of AI technologies enables the Company to deliver more effective and efficient social media advertising services and to enhance its competitor monitoring services, with the aim of providing clients with more comprehensive insights against which to benchmark their marketing activities.

The principal services provided by Voltage X comprise:

Digital Marketing: lead generation, content generation, social media oversight, and both placement and programmatic advertising. The Company's VXAds platform utilises AI technology to develop customised marketing campaigns, and to support client engagement and conversion rates.

Content Creation: professional photography for events, marketing materials, websites and social media; video production for promotional videos, product demonstrations, explainer videos and corporate videos; and logo design, brand strategy and creative content development.

Marketing Analytics: the Company's VXMonitor platform provides clients with data on campaign performance, audience behaviour insights and AI-driven recommendations to optimise marketing strategies. The platform also provides competitor marketing monitoring and analytics, enabling clients to benchmark their advertising campaigns against those of their peers.

Public Relations: the Company's in-house public relations division uses its industry relationships and data-driven insights to seek media coverage, manage crisis communications and support the thought leadership positioning of its clients.

Influencer Management: the Company maintains a network of vetted influencers across a range of social media platforms, and oversees influencer engagements, content production and campaign effectiveness assessments.

Historically, the Group has focussed on the property sector, working with property developers and shopping mall operators.  The Group is successfully diversifying it customer base, notably in the sports sector with new clients in the sporting brands and venues spaces.

Hong Kong is the main country of operation, from where customers are served across Australia, Hong Kong, UK, Taiwan and the Middle East.
